speaker: KAYA ASTREA
description: A young female noble magic academy student with a clear, youthful timbre and an articulate, aristocratic speech pattern. Her pace is crisp and disciplined when calm, but rapidly quickens into breathless, stammering bursts when flustered or overthinking. She maintains a polite and earnest emotional baseline, though she is easily embarrassed, prone to dramatic internal panic, and deeply respectful when addressing those she admires.
ref_text: Y-Yes, Sir Isaac! I was merely conducting a routine investigation—I certainly wasn't following you or anything like that!
